name: Link16 NPG Priority Scheduling Workflow
description: Per-NPG priority queues with terminal preemption and staleness purge (STANAG 5516 Section 4.6)

stages.name: Enqueue Host Message
stages.description: Place a host message into the transmit queue of its NPG

stages.name: Terminal Maintenance Preempt
stages.description: Terminal-generated maintenance message preempts queued host messages

stages.name: Dispatch Next Slot
stages.description: Purge stale entries and transmit the highest-priority eligible message

stages.name: Purge Stale
stages.description: Remove messages exceeding their staleness limit
